title: Settings
description: Workspace details, policies and data export.

showOnce.warning: This value will not be shown again. Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe.
showOnce.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the value by hand.

profile.tenantHint: These appear on documents and reports.
profile.name: Workspace name
profile.farmHint: Land and documents are kept under Farm passport.
profile.coordinatesHint: Weather and the map use this point.

policy.approvalThresholdHint: Transactions at or above this amount need a manager's approval.
policy.overheadBaseHint: General costs are shared across fields and herds on this basis.
policy.makerCheckerHint: The person who enters a transaction cannot approve it.
policy.currencyHint: Cannot change after the first transaction.
policy.costingMethodHint: Stock issues are valued with this method.
policy.winterDaysHint: Used to calculate the feed requirement.
policy.minStockDaysHint: An alert appears when stock covers fewer days than this.
policy.deviationPercentHint: An alert appears when daily feeding differs from the norm by this much.
policy.storageHint: Uploads stop at these limits, so that files always leave the database room on the server's disk.
policy.dailyUploadMbHint: At least {{maxMb}} MB: the size of the largest file.
policy.gestationDaysHint: Expected lambing dates are calculated from this.
policy.enforce2faHint: Owner, director and accountant sign in with a code from an app.
policy.enforce2faOff: Two-factor sign-in is off. The specification requires it for managers and the accountant, so turn it off only for testing.
policy.retentionTitle: How long passing data is kept
policy.retentionHint: Anything older is removed every night. Financial records, the event journal, the audit log and files are never removed.
policy.aiToolDataDaysHint: The assistant's answers stay. Only what it looked up for them is removed.
policy.importDaysHint: Personal data from an uploaded spreadsheet. An import nobody finished is removed whole.
policy.trackerReadingsDaysHint: Every position and temperature as it came in. Each animal's daily summary stays. 7 to 365 days.
policy.idempotencyDaysHint: A record sent twice from a phone is recognised for this long. At least 30 days.

data.title: Data export
data.description: You can download all of this farm's data at any time.
data.scopeNote: The export covers the current farm. Passwords and keys are left out. Every export is recorded in the journal.

users.title: Users and roles
users.description: Who works on this farm and which sections they can open.
users.addHint: A new phone gets a one-time password. Someone who already has an account gets an invitation and decides for themselves.
users.invited: Invitation sent. {{name}} joins once they accept.
users.cancelInvitationBody: {{name}} will not be able to accept it.
users.reset2faBody: {{name}} will connect an authenticator app again at the next sign-in. All their sessions end.
users.addedExisting: {{name}} was added and will sign in with their own password.
users.name: Full name
users.resetBody: A new one-time password will be created for {{name}}. Their old password and all sessions stop working.
users.blockBody: {{name}} loses access immediately. The records they entered are kept.
users.passwordBody: Give this password to {{name}}. It is only for their first sign-in: they choose their own right after.

roles.piiHint: Phones, passports, salaries and employee names. Do not give this to investors.
roles.financeSummaryHint: Aggregated figures on the dashboard and investor report. The journal and accounts stay closed.
roles.financeCapitalHint: Put the owner's own money into the farm and take it back out. Neither is income or expense.
roles.cannotGrant: You do not have this right, so you cannot grant it
roles.ownerLocked: This role's rights are locked so the workspace can never lose its administrator.
roles.name: Role name
roles.addHint: Start a new role empty, or copy an existing one.
roles.copyFromHint: Only rights you hold yourself are copied.

apiKeys.title: Integrations
apiKeys.description: API keys and webhooks for cameras, sensors and outside systems.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.nameHint: Say which device or system this key is for.
apiKeys.hint: Cameras and sensors send events with this key. The format is in the API documentation at /api/docs.
apiKeys.emptyBody: Create a key to connect a camera or sensor.
apiKeys.revokeBody: The key "{{name}}" stops working immediately. Devices using it can no longer send events.
apiKeys.createdBody: Enter this key in the device's settings.

files.usageHint: The workspace's photos and documents. One file can be up to {{maxMb}} MB. The limits are changed under Policies.
files.uploadedToday: Your uploads in the last 24 hours
files.unusedHintOwn: Files you uploaded that no record points at. Deleting one frees its space.
files.unusedHintAll: Files no record points at, whoever uploaded them. Deleting one frees its space.
files.name: File
files.emptyBody: Every stored file is attached to a record.

webhooks.hint: Events such as sales, lambings and alerts are sent to an outside system. Every message is signed.
webhooks.urlHint: Only addresses on the public internet are accepted.
webhooks.eventsHint: One per line: sale.*, animal.lambed, or * for everything.
webhooks.emptyBody: Add a webhook to send events to an outside system.
webhooks.createdBody: Verify message signatures with this secret.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who changed what and when, with the old and new values.
audit.noVisibleChanges: No changes you are allowed to see.

errors.CURRENCY_LOCKED: The base currency cannot change once transactions exist.
errors.INVALID_PHONE: This phone number is not valid.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person already works on this farm.
errors.CANNOT_GRANT_PERMISSION: You cannot grant a right you do not have.
errors.CANNOT_MANAGE_HIGHER_ROLE: This person has more rights than you do.
errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ROLE: You cannot change your own role.
errors.CANNOT_RESET_SELF: Change your own password from the profile menu.
errors.LAST_OWNER: The workspace must keep at least one active owner.
errors.ALREADY_INVITED: This person has already been invited.
errors.INVITATION_CLOSED: This invitation has already been answered.
errors.USER_HAS_OTHER_WORKSPACES: This account also reaches beyond this workspace. Only the person or the platform administrator can do this.
errors.OWNER_ROLE_LOCKED: The owner role cannot be changed.
errors.SYSTEM_ROLE: A standard role cannot be renamed or deleted.
errors.ROLE_IN_USE: This role is assigned to people. Change their role first.
errors.WEBHOOK_URL_NOT_ALLOWED: Events cannot be sent there. Use a public https address.
